'''BXL-99 labor droids''', often referred to as '''Bee-Ex-Ell-Ninety-nines''', were a type of labor [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. Standing about two meters tall, they were very heavy, and were equipped with a pair of three-pronged pincers. Three such droids were present in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Factory District]] [[Factory District droid plant|droid plant]], until they were destroyed by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-in-hiding [[Jax Pavan]] and the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[I-5YQ]].<ref name="JT" />
